packages.summary: A relaxed Almaty holiday with a Shymbulak cable car ride, a full city tour, Kok Tobe Hill, Green Bazaar and time to shop.
packages.overview: Simply Almaty is built around Kazakhstan's most relaxed city, with the Tian Shan mountains always in view. You ride the three-tier gondola up to Shymbulak, tour the main sights of the city and go up Kok Tobe Hill by cable car. There is time at Green Bazaar and at Almaty's malls, so you can pick up spices, dried fruits and gifts at your own pace.

group_trips.title: Almaty Lakes, Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure group trip pairing Almaty's cable cars and Big Almaty Lake with Charyn Canyon, Kolsai Lakes and Lake Kaindy.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip pairs the best of Almaty with the wild country to its east. You ride up to Shymbulak, visit Medeu and see the turquoise water of Big Almaty Lake, then head out to the Valley of Castles in Charyn Canyon.

An overnight stay near the Kolsai Lakes lets you see the alpine lakes and Lake Kaindy, famous for its sunken spruce trunks, without a rushed day. A trip captain travels with the group throughout, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Almaty city tour with Kok Tobe Hill by cable car
Shymbulak by cable car and Medeu, the high-altitude skating rink
Big Almaty Lake in the Trans-Ili Alatau mountains
Valley of Castles in Charyn Canyon
Kolsai Lakes and Lake Kaindy with its sunken spruce trunks
Overnight stay near the Kolsai Lakes for an unhurried visit
Trip captain and Indian meal options on request

Overnight stay in Almaty.

group_trips.title: Almaty Mountains and Astana Skyline Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure group trip from the mountain backdrop of Almaty to the modern skyline of Astana, with a domestic flight between the two.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip shows two very different sides of Kazakhstan. In Almaty you ride the cable cars up Kok Tobe and Shymbulak, visit Medeu and spend a morning at Big Almaty Lake, with the mountains always in view.

A short domestic flight then takes you to Astana, the capital, where bold modern architecture rises from the steppe. You see Baiterek Tower and the Hazrat Sultan Mosque with a trip captain beside you, and Indian meal options are available on request.

group_trips.title: Almaty Weekend Escape: Big Almaty Lake, Shymbulak and Kok Tobe
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure long weekend in Almaty with Kok Tobe, Shymbulak, Medeu and the turquoise water of Big Almaty Lake, led by a trip captain.
group_trips.overview:
Almaty sits at the foot of the Tian Shan mountains, which makes it one of the easiest places to enjoy real mountain scenery on a long weekend. This trip keeps a relaxed pace, with one or two headline sights each day and plenty of time to walk, shop and sit over a cup of tea.

You ride the cable car up Kok Tobe Hill, visit Green Bazaar, go up to Shymbulak via Medeu and spend a morning at Big Almaty Lake. A trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options are available on request. If you would rather see Charyn Canyon, ask us about swapping it in for the lake day; it is a long drive, so it suits a full day.
highlights: Almaty city tour with Kok Tobe Hill by cable car
Green Bazaar for spices, dried fruits and local sweets
Medeu, the high-altitude skating rink, and Shymbulak by cable car
Big Almaty Lake in the Trans-Ili Alatau mountains
Panfilov Park, Zenkov Cathedral and an evening stroll on Arbat Street
Trip captain and Indian meal options on request
